Class View

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants
public class View extends JFrame
The View class extends JFrame and manages the Graphical User Interface (GUI) of the application. It contains all the visual components (Buttons, Labels, Panels) and methods to switch between screens (Main Menu, Game Window, Help, Game Over).

    • MainMenu

      public void MainMenu()
      Renders the Main Menu screen. Clears the current content pane and adds the logo and main menu buttons. Pre-condition: The JFrame exists. Post-condition: The window displays the Main Menu with "New Game", "Load", and "Exit" options.

    • GameWindow

      public void GameWindow(String gameMode)
      Renders the main Game Window. Sets up the split layout: the Game Board (Left) and the Player Sidebar (Right). Pre-condition: gameMode is a valid string (e.g., "Singleplayer"). Post-condition: The UI is populated with the board, inventory slots, character cards, and control buttons.
      Parameters:
      gameMode - The name of the current game mode to display in the title.

    • GameOver

      public void GameOver(String[] winner)
      Renders the Game Over screen. Displays the winner and the final score. Pre-condition: The game has ended and a winner has been determined. Post-condition: The window clears and shows the victory message and a button to return to the menu.
      Parameters:
      winner - An array containing [Winner Name, Score].

    • HelpScreen

      public void HelpScreen()
      Renders the Help Screen. Displays the rules and guide image. Pre-condition: User clicked the Help (?) button. Post-condition: The window displays the help assets and a "Go Back" button.

    • GetLabelIndexFromName

      public List<Integer> GetLabelIndexFromName(List<String> names)
      Finds the index of board tiles based on a list of names. Pre-condition: names list is not null. Post-condition: Returns a list of indexes corresponding to the names found on the board.
      Parameters:
      names - List of tile names to search for.
      Returns:
      List of integer indexes.

    • GetAllCountsFromTheBoard

      public int[] GetAllCountsFromTheBoard()
      Collects the current count of every tile on the board. Post-condition: Returns an array of integers representing the board state.
      Returns:
      int array of size 16.

    • ResetView

      public void ResetView()
      Resets all board tile counts to zero. Post-condition: All board visuals show count 0.
